metadata.title: Arab Futures Society
metadata.description: Exploring and shaping the future of the Arab world through foresight and collaborative knowledge.

hero.title: Arab Futures Society
hero.slogan: A collaborative platform for building a shared lexicon of future-oriented concepts in the Arab world.

features.label: Research & Analysis
features.heading: Deep Dives into Future Trends
features.description: We systematically identify, analyze, and synthesize emerging trends relevant to the Arab world, from technological shifts to social dynamics.

features.label: Community & Collaboration
features.heading: Building a Network of Futurists
features.description: We facilitate workshops, discussions, and collaborative projects to build a vibrant community dedicated to foresight.

about.title: About Arab Futures Society
about.p1: We are a collective of thinkers, creators, and innovators dedicated to exploring and shaping the future of the Arab world through foresight, research, and collaborative projects.
about.breakoutDescription: We aspire to make foresight equitable and connected, accessible to all and reflective of our shared humanity. are guided by an Arab ethos of trust, humility, and courage before the unknown, acting with clarity even amid uncertainty.

ParticipatoryAndInclusive.label: Inclusion & Collective Ownership
ParticipatoryAndInclusive.value: We are participatory, fostering inclusion and collective ownership of the future.

UpholdingAgency.label: Empowerment & Agency
UpholdingAgency.value: We uphold agency, empowering individuals and institutions to shape their own trajectories.

ChampioningRepresentation.label: Authentic Arab Representation
ChampioningRepresentation.value: We champion representation, so Arab futures are told by Arab voices.

impaPioneeringAndAdaptivect.label: Pioneering & Future-Focused
impaPioneeringAndAdaptivect.value: We are pioneering, driven to challenge, adapt, and create what our region needs.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A future where the Arab world is a global leader in innovation, culture, and sustainable development, driven by the foresight and creativity of its people.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To cultivate a foresight culture across the Arab region by providing accessible knowledge, fostering collaborative networks, and initiating impactful future-oriented projects.

features.heading: The Futures Lexicon
features.label: Ongoing Project
features.description: Our primary initiative is the creation of a comprehensive, bilingual (Arabic/English), open-source lexicon of terms related to future studies, technology, and societal transformation. It serves as a foundational tool for researchers, policymakers, and the public.
